data_dir.tooltip: Where prompts.json and backups are stored. Leave empty to use ~/.local/share/prompt-vault@alex/. You may use ~ for your home folder. Click Import and pick any .json backup from this folder.

auto_backup.description: Keep a rolling backup on every change
auto_backup.tooltip: Maintains prompts.auto-backup.json next to your data so a save can never lose your previous state.

always_copy_raw.tooltip: Copy prompts exactly as stored, including any {{placeholders}}. Turn off to open a fill-in form when a prompt has placeholders.

confirm_delete.tooltip: Show a confirmation dialog before a prompt is removed.

default_filter.description: Default filter when the desklet starts
default_filter.tooltip: Applied on startup and after reload. You can still change the filter chips anytime during the session.

default_category.tooltip: Used when Default filter is “Specific category…”. Match the category name as shown on the chips (e.g. General).

show_tags.tooltip: Display the prompt's tags in the list.

show_usage.description: Show how often each prompt is copied
show_usage.tooltip: Display a small 'Copied N×' line under each prompt.

panel_width.tooltip: Overall width of the desklet. Wider widths show more of each prompt title.

list_height.tooltip: Height of the scrollable prompt list. Toolbar buttons stay fixed below this area.
